findings.issue: A follow-up replaces the original baseCommitHash with its own start commit, excluding initial changes from ownership, artifact and verification checks.
Queued invocations bypass fresh preflight, project/global budget checks, team reservations and daily attempt admission.
Configured costPerRunUsd is charged only once even when queued turns invoke the engine multiple times.
An unknown-cost failed follow-up replaces the entire attempt's known spending with one failure estimate; thrown follow-ups omit their charge altogether.
A follow-up that reports a worker spawn and then throws is swallowed as prior success, allowing merge and writer release without verified termination.
STEER uses non-atomic select/update, while QUEUE remains pending throughout async dispatch: concurrent consumers can deliver twice and expiry sweeps can overwrite a dispatched instruction with STALE.
Active records omit project identity, allowing a project-authorized request to target another project sharing the same dataDir.
A nested infrastructure retry marks every same-process execution orphaned, including live concurrent sibling tasks.
Requests in host-verify receive QUEUED/TOO_LATE_QUEUED even though the last delivery boundary has already passed.
Each additional prompt starts from the original directive, discarding earlier operator instructions on stateless adapters.
The automatic no-commit nudge starts before an already queued operator instruction reaches the first safe follow-up turn.
REJECTED_REPLAY returns a new envelope ID without persisting its receipt, so controls listing cannot retrieve every request.
CLI ControlStore is constructed without EventLog, omitting control-request audit events including rejected requests.
Discord status/monitor displays only eight execution ID characters although intake requires the complete exact ID.
Unknown usage in one turn is treated as zero; thrown follow-ups retain earlier complete-usage claims, overstating accounting coverage.
History is never pruned but an inventory over 10,000 files returns empty, permanently hiding live executions and preventing orphan discovery.
PID existence alone treats an old execution as live when that PID is reused; hostStartedAt is recorded but never verified.
Validation accepts 400 Unicode code points but storage slices 400 UTF-16 code units, silently truncating valid operator instructions and potentially splitting a surrogate pair.

needs-human: Every non-throwing engine result is labeled delivered, including pre-dispatch refusals such as freebuff-session-busy. Correct positive acknowledgement requires an explicit adapter result contract; it cannot safely be inferred from ok/failureReason.

needs-human: Only mock implements in-flight STEER. Issue #11 requires genuine long-running native-engine, Discord, restart and destructive-boundary runtime evidence before VERIFIED; mock tests and CLI smoke do not satisfy this acceptance gate.

summary: Fixed 18 actionable findings with 30 red-to-green regressions; final typecheck, build and 17 related suites (192 tests) pass. A broader run before the final host-base fallback guard had 2018 passed and 9 failed; all 9 failures reproduced on the unmodified admitted head. needs-human: native STEER/runtime acceptance and an explicit adapter delivery-acknowledgement contract remain unresolved; issue #11 is not VERIFIED.
